shots.visual: 天穹裂开巨大缺口，金色雨水倒灌人间，白衣无面的天道使者从裂缝里缓缓垂落。
shots.dialogue: 天道使者：天弃之子，归位。
shots.prompt_en: giant crack in the sky, golden rain pouring upward into the heavens, faceless celestial envoy in white robes descending slowly from the rift, vast sky, glowing golden light

shots.visual: 天穹裂口下方，金雨落在焦土上冒起白烟，云层被撕成碎片，光柱贯穿天地。
shots.action: 金雨落土冒烟、光柱摇晃
shots.prompt_en: giant crack in sky, golden rain falling on scorched earth, white smoke rising, shattered clouds, pillar of light piercing heaven and earth, dramatic lighting

shots.visual: 使者抬手一指，金光贯穿老墨胸口，铁杖断成两截落地，老人跪倒，血滴在焦土上。
shots.prompt_en: messenger raising hand pointing, golden light beam piercing old man's chest, iron staff broken in two falling, old man kneeling, blood dripping on scorched earth, dark battlefield, harsh golden glow

shots.visual: 林昭低头看胸口，第三道锁正在崩解，金光从裂缝里漏出，映亮他半张脸和发红的眼眶。
shots.action: 低头、锁链崩解、金光漏出
shots.prompt_en: Lin Zhao, looking down at his chest, third seal cracking apart, golden light leaking from fissures, illuminating half his face, reddened eyes, dark surroundings, dramatic glow

shots.visual: 他抬手捏碎最后一道锁，雷海冲天而起，把白衣使者撕成漫天金屑，云层当场退开。
shots.prompt_en: male cultivator, raising hand, crushing final seal, thunder sea erupting skyward, white-robed envoy shredded into golden dust, clouds parting, stormy sky, intense lightning glow, dramatic backlighting

shots.visual: 雷海散尽，天穹金眼闭合又睁开，金光凝成一个金袍人形落在他面前，单膝跪下低头行礼。
shots.action: 金光凝聚成形、单膝跪地
shots.dialogue: 金袍人形：终于，见到你了。
shots.prompt_en: thunder sea dissipating, giant golden eye in sky closing and reopening, golden light condensing into humanoid figure in golden robes, landing before him, kneeling on one knee, bowing head in salute, golden radiance, dramatic lighting
